body.title: Refresh tool schema and build contract assertions
body.reproduction: Git approval/schema snapshots reject existing git_diff.objectPair and git_cat_file.metadataOnly fields. The typecheck-config test expects the build string to start with tsc even though it now cleans output and builds the memory workspace first. The spawn-scan build test hardcodes three exemptions but the scanner now has a justified managed-release-staging exemption.
body.rootCause: Historical literal snapshots assert old schemas and build/exemption lists instead of the currently intended contracts. These failures are distinct from GitHub CLI command/flag coverage and from output-directory races.
body.fixIntent: Reconcile git tool schema, build-step ordering and spawn-exemption assertions with their authoritative current contracts, preserving validation, per-input approval checks and explicit reasons for every exemption. Acceptance: git schema/approval, build-script, typecheck-config and scanner tests pass with meaningful negative controls; an unexpected field, bypassed typecheck or unjustified exemption still fails. Do not weaken runtime validation merely to match snapshots.
